程序包 org.bukkit.block

接口 CommandBlock

所有超级接口:
BlockState, CommandBlockHolder, Metadatable, PersistentDataHolder, PersistentDataViewHolder, TileState
public interface CommandBlock extends TileState, CommandBlockHolder
代表命令方块.

原文： Represents a captured state of a command block.

  • 方法详细资料

    • getCommand

      @NotNull @NotNull java.lang.String getCommand()
      获取这个命令方块激活时运行的命令。本方法不会返回null，若此命令方块还没有设置命令，会返回空字符.

      原文： Gets the command that this CommandBlock will run when powered. This will never return null. If the CommandBlock does not have a command, an empty String will be returned instead.

      指定者:
      getCommand 在接口中 CommandBlockHolder
      返回:
      当激活时这个命令方块将要运行的命令

      原文：Command that this CommandBlock will run when powered.

    • setCommand

      void setCommand(@Nullable @Nullable java.lang.String command)
      设置这个命令方块激活时运行的命令。设置这个命令为null等价于设置命令为空字符串.

      原文： Sets the command that this CommandBlock will run when powered. Setting the command to null is the same as setting it to an empty String.

      指定者:
      setCommand 在接口中 CommandBlockHolder
      参数:
      command - 当激活时这个命令方块将要运行的命令

      原文：Command that this CommandBlock will run when powered.

    • getName

      @Deprecated @NotNull @NotNull java.lang.String getName()
      已过时。
      in favour of name()
      获取这个命令方块的名字.这个名字被用于命令方块执行命令。这个名字永远不会为空，默认为“@”.

      原文： Gets the name of this CommandBlock. The name is used with commands that this CommandBlock executes. This name will never be null, and by default is "@".

      返回:
      这个命令方块的名字

      原文：Name of this CommandBlock.

    • setName

      已过时。
      in favour of name(net.kyori.adventure.text.Component)
      设置这个命令方块的名字。这个名字用于命令方块执行命令。设置名字为null等价于设置为“@”.

      原文： Sets the name of this CommandBlock. The name is used with commands that this CommandBlock executes. Setting the name to null is the same as setting it to "@".

      参数:
      name - 这个命令方块的新名字

      原文：New name for this CommandBlock.
